name: banknote
useCase: Identify cash or a cash payment option beside its label.
misuse: Do not use this generic banknote to specify a currency, amount, or payment status.

16.reason: A clear central stamp keeps the banknote recognizable without tiny corner marks; the stamp leaves 1px to the upper and lower borders.

24.reason: A larger stamp and two circular corner marks remain distinct, with at least 1.5px of space between unrelated marks and the frame.
